description: R6 — executable debugger evaluation of a real model (raw base or tuned adapter) on the DISJOINT QuixBugs validation set under the frozen r5.9 treatment.

timeout_derivation.rule: ONE common pdb_request_timeout_seconds frozen at 60 s (the accepted live-condition r5.1 measurement); reused unchanged for the R6 trajectory generation.

treatment.debugger_entrypoint: target script = task's single writable production path (constraints.allowed_write_paths); disposable fixture copy receives one neutral cwd-safe guarded pytest launcher generated mechanically from task.reproduction.argv; the SCRIPTED transport authors break <n> among original-source eligible lines (harness-selected from the gold changed region for training tasks).
treatment.stack_rendering: model-facing stack rendering filtered to frames with script == production path and 1 <= line <= original_source_line_count in EVERY prompt block; raw payload evidence complete.
treatment.model_context: title + description from agent_visible_mapping; original production source; mechanical eligible breakpoint lines; real debugger/tool observations (production-region filtered); SANITIZED reproduction diagnostic; SANITIZED verifier failure records. No test source, no assertion/literal content, no node ids, no oracle, no reference repair.
treatment.state_machine: accepted R5.9 staged machine: reproduce -> break -> stack -> locals -> step/next -> EITHER stack G2>G1 OR real terminal outcome OR production-exception path -> diagnosis -> bounded PATCH (whole-file 'file' representation) -> PatchManager -> administrative closeout -> EvaluationVerifier.
treatment.patch_serialization: whole-file repair representation: the transport authors the complete corrected file content; the deterministic layer generates the unified diff (difflib, recorded+hashed), then normalizes it.  PatchManager and EvaluationVerifier receive C only.
treatment.budget: one common budget (see budgets); no per-task prompt tuning.

source_baseline.note: R6 training data generation; descends from the R6 branch state containing the r5.9 clean-holdout treatment.
